title: Measure PPO policy drift and isolate observation normalization
summary: We add measurements before and after stock PPO updates and an explicit option to disable running observation statistics. CPU replay establishes policy drift with fixed weights; a separate reward audit measures delayed movement credit. We retain reward v2 and define a fresh native comparison. Walking remains unqualified.
next: Run the fresh normalization comparison after host and input preflights pass, then evaluate all 13 probes with native force and torque records. Use that result to decide whether a separate reward revision is needed.
